user_reported_bug: Real user testing (founder's wife, fresh account, real usage) surfaced 4 issues. P0: A wall correctly identified as 'matte wall paint' was matched against LAMINATE catalogue at 88% confidence, not paint. A separate region with family 'Other'/undefined still confidently served 80% laminate. Flooring matched laminate instead of tile/stone. Root cause is family-alternatives widen firing even when family is confidently known via object-lock. Correct behavior: object_locked=True must NEVER widen; alt-family similarity must be penalized (0.7 not 1.0); Other/undefined wall must default to Paints only, not Paints+Laminates. P1: rug pin lands on book on rug — use polygon centroid. P1: hover highlight too subtle — scale + glow + dim others. P1: click-to-enlarge lightbox for shortlisted swatches.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused retest verified the two follow-up fixes pass (Other/undefined wall now locks to Paints only; shortlist swatch fields persist and render in the lightbox), pytest has 25/25 passing, real-image wall/ceiling rows did not leak Laminates, polygon centroid and hover/lightbox UI passed. However the original flooring part is still not fixed: a Tile floor row with low-confidence Laminate alternative widens into Laminates because floor routing is not object_locked, returning Laminate catalogue matches alongside Tiles.

critical.issue: Tile flooring edge case still leaks Laminate catalogue matches. Direct row object_type='floor', material_family='Tile', material_type='ivory stone tile floor', family_confidence=0.5, family_alternatives=['Laminate'] has Brain allowed_categories=['Tiles','Stone'] but object_locked is missing/False; _find_catalogue_matches widens retrieval to Laminates and returns Laminate matches at 79%, 78%, 62%, 62%, 61%. This violates the reported 'flooring matched laminate instead of tile/stone' fix requirement for Tile/Stone floors.

action_items: Object-lock floor routing when object_type='floor' and material_family is confidently Tile/Stone/Wood, or otherwise pass object_locked=True / suppress alt-family widen for Tile/Stone flooring rows so Laminates cannot enter the retrieval pool unless the floor is explicitly wood/laminate-routed.

Add a regression test for object_type='floor', material_family='Tile', family_confidence<0.7, family_alternatives=['Laminate'] asserting retrieval categories exclude Laminates/Veneers and returned matches stay Tiles/Stone.
Align Brain flooring reasoning text with actual allowed categories; it currently says flooring searches Laminates/Veneers even when allowed_categories is ['Tiles','Stone'].
critical_code_review_comments: backend/server.py materialmatch_brain handles object-locked walls/ceilings but not floors. Flooring uses legacy app_ctx='flooring' route with object_locked unset, so _find_catalogue_matches low-confidence family_alternatives widen can still add Laminates even when Brain allowed_categories is ['Tiles','Stone'].

backend/server.py _CATEGORY_LIBRARIES maps Stone/Marble to ['Stone','Tiles','Laminates']; that may be legitimate for feature walls/countertops, but floor-specific Tile/Stone routing needs a hard gate or lock to avoid the user-reported floor->laminate regression.
